name: Gara Aeroport Henri Coandă

sources.label: OSM w813193384 · building=train_station, layer=1, min_height=5, building:levels=2, roof:shape=gabled, covered=arcade
District dossier: CFR airport station, barrel-vaulted green-ribbed canopy
Fidelity pass round 2 (9824fd5), not yet published when captured

improvements: The CFR airport station (opened 2020-12-13) on its mapped 169 × 18 m strip: a concrete box-girder deck on wall piers with crossheads, a green edge band, one long glazed barrel vault on a white lattice over the platforms, and an open stair with green rails climbing to the west end. It replaces a flat green-topped slab on thin columns, and only that footprint.
remainingGaps: Documented exception: the vault follows the official panoramas (viewed only); the mapped roof:shape=gabled is the nearest tag. Deck depth, vault rise (the two mapped levels, 5 to 13 m), pier spacing and the stair's place are estimates.

In the isolated viewer there is no road data, so every estimated pier is drawn; in the district world piers are left out where a mapped road passes under the deck. The model uses its embedded copy of the source ring (OTP_GARA_RING) here and the district source ring in the world.
districtOnly background scenery in Otopeni; no in-world capture was made for this record.
